intro: Utah's canyon country has one genuinely unusual feature: the off-road community around Moab still runs CB radio on 27 MHz, decades after everyone else abandoned it. Your VX-6R receives down to 500 kHz, so you can listen to a Jeep convoy picking its way up Hell's Revenge in AM on the 11 metre band — something almost no modern handheld can do. Beyond that, five national parks in one state means the federal band is where most of the real information lives.
introz: 犹他的峡谷地带有一个真正特别的地方：摩押一带的越野圈至今仍在 27 MHz 使用 CB 电台，比所有人放弃它已经晚了几十年。VX-6R 最低可收到 500 kHz，所以你可以用 AM 在 11 米波段上听一支吉普车队一点点爬上 Hell's Revenge——这是几乎所有现代手台都做不到的事。除此之外，一个州里有五座国家公园，意味着真正有用的信息大多在联邦波段上。

stations.n: CB Ch 4 — the Moab off-road channel
stations.z: CB 4 频道 · 摩押越野频道
stations.d: Four-wheel-drive groups on the Moab trails have used CB channel 4 as their convention for decades, and Easter Jeep Safari week turns the 27 MHz band into the busiest thing in the county. Set the VX-6 to AM and tune down — hearing a spotter talk a driver over an obstacle, one tyre at a time, is oddly compelling. Channel 1 is 26.965 and the band runs up to 27.405 in 40 channels.
stations.dz: 摩押越野线路上的四驱车队几十年来一直把 CB 4 频道作为惯例，复活节吉普大会那一周，27 MHz 会成为全县最热闹的频段。把 VX-6 设为 AM 往下调——听一个指挥员一个轮子一个轮子地把司机引过障碍，出乎意料地引人入胜。1 频道是 26.965，整个频段到 27.405，共 40 个信道。

stations.z: CB 19 频道 · 公路频道
stations.d: The traditional trucker channel nationwide. Much quieter than it was in the seventies, but on I-70 and I-15 there is still traffic and road information.
stations.dz: 全美传统的货车司机频道。比七十年代清静许多，但在 70 号和 15 号州际公路上仍有通话和路况信息。

stations.z: CB 1 频道 · 频段起点

stations.n: FRS and GMRS — the newer convention
stations.z: FRS 与 GMRS · 较新的惯例
stations.d: Younger groups and commercial tour operators have moved to GMRS. Scan both bands and you will hear the generational split in the off-road community quite clearly.
stations.dz: 更年轻的队伍和商业旅游公司已转向 GMRS。把两个频段都扫一遍，能相当清楚地听出越野圈里的代际差异。

stations.z: 拱门与峡谷地国家公园
stations.d: Ranger operations, entry-queue management at Arches, and technical rescues in the Needles and the Maze. Scan 162–174 MHz in NFM once you are in the park.
stations.dz: 护林员作业、拱门的入园排队管理，以及 Needles 和 Maze 区域的技术救援。进园后用 NFM 扫 162–174 MHz。

stations.d: Shuttle operations, Angels Landing incidents and canyoneering rescues in the Narrows.
stations.dz: 摆渡车调度、天使降临步道事故和 Narrows 峡谷探险救援。

stations.z: 布莱斯与圆顶礁国家公园

stations.d: Helicopter rescues off the canyon walls are coordinated through interagency aviation nets.
stations.dz: 峡谷岩壁上的直升机救援通过跨部门航空网协调。

stations.z: 土地管理局 · 摩押办公室
stations.d: Most of the land around Moab is BLM rather than Park Service. Different agency, same 162–174 MHz federal block.
stations.dz: 摩押周边大部分土地属土地管理局而非国家公园局。机构不同，但同在 162–174 MHz 联邦频段。

stations.d: Canyon terrain blocks VHF badly — down in a slot canyon you will hear nothing at all. From a rim viewpoint like Dead Horse Point or the Island in the Sky, the same radio covers an enormous area. Elevation is everything here.
stations.dz: 峡谷地形对 VHF 遮挡极强——在狭缝峡谷底部什么都收不到。而在 Dead Horse Point 或 Island in the Sky 这样的崖顶观景点，同一台电台能覆盖极大范围。在这里，海拔决定一切。

stations.d: Utah has one of the best-organised statewide linked repeater networks in the country, built partly for emergency communications. Coverage reaches into surprisingly remote canyon country. Confirm current details on RepeaterBook for Grand and Salt Lake counties.
stations.dz: 犹他有全美组织最好的全州链接中继网络之一，部分是为应急通信而建，覆盖能延伸到相当偏远的峡谷地区。请在 RepeaterBook 查 Grand 和 Salt Lake 县确认当前参数。

stations.d: UHF sometimes works better than 2 m in slickrock canyons because the signal bounces off the walls.
stations.dz: 在光滑砂岩峡谷里，UHF 有时比 2 米更好，因为信号会在岩壁上反射。

stations.d: Scenic flights over the canyons and the Moab skydiving operation. Also try 122.700 and 123.000 at outlying strips.
stations.dz: 峡谷观光飞行和摩押的跳伞作业。其他简易机场可试 122.700 和 123.000。

stations.d: Sweep 118–128 MHz. Salt Lake is a Delta hub with heavy connecting traffic.
stations.dz: 扫 118–128 MHz。盐湖城是达美的枢纽，中转流量很大。

stations.n: Military UHF — Utah Test and Training Range
stations.z: 军用 UHF · 犹他试验与训练靶场
stations.d: The vast restricted range west of Salt Lake, and Hill Air Force Base to the north. Set the VX-6 to AM and sweep 225–380 MHz.
stations.dz: 盐湖城以西的巨大限制靶场，以及北面的 Hill 空军基地。把 VX-6 设为 AM，扫 225–380 MHz。

stations.z: NOAA 摩押 / 犹他东南
stations.d: Flash-flood warnings for the slot canyons. In monsoon season, from July through September, this is the difference between a good day and a fatal one.
stations.dz: 狭缝峡谷的暴洪警报。七月到九月的季风季，这就是好日子和致命日子之间的区别。

stations.d: The line along the Green and Price rivers, and the potash spur down to Moab. Remote track with long stretches of nothing.
stations.dz: 沿 Green 河和 Price 河的线路，以及通往摩押的钾盐支线。轨道偏远，很长路段空无一物。

stations.d: Listener-supported and volunteer-programmed since 1979, and a genuine outlier in Utah's media landscape.
stations.dz: 自 1979 年起由听众资助、志愿者编排，在犹他的媒体格局里是个真正的异类。

stations.d: Coverage in canyon country comes from small translators perched on mesas, so what you receive changes dramatically over a few miles of driving.
stations.dz: 峡谷地带的覆盖靠架在台地上的小型转播台，所以开几英里，能收到的东西就完全不同。

stations.z: 公园旅客信息台 · 中波
stations.d: Zion and Arches both run low-power AM loops near the entrances with timed-entry and closure information. Watch for the roadside signs — the frequency varies between 530 and 1710 kHz.
stations.dz: 锡安和拱门都在入口附近有小功率中波循环播报，内容包括预约入园和封闭信息。注意路边指示牌——频率在 530–1710 kHz 之间。

stations.d: Grand County Search and Rescue is one of the busiest volunteer teams in the country, thanks to the canyons.
stations.dz: 因为这些峡谷，Grand 县搜救队是全美出勤最频繁的志愿队伍之一。

stations.d: Canyoneering guides, rafting outfitters and the constant stream of film and advertising shoots.
stations.dz: 峡谷探险向导、漂流公司，以及络绎不绝的影视和广告拍摄团队。

stations.d: Dark-sky country with essentially no RF noise. From a mesa top this is about as good as it gets in the lower 48.
stations.dz: 暗夜保护区，几乎没有射频噪声。在台地顶上，这是美国本土能达到的最好条件。

stations.d: Fort Collins is close, so all five frequencies come in well here too.
stations.dz: 距柯林斯堡很近，五个频率在这里也都收得不错。
